purpose: A three-chapter customer-facing journey presenter; supporting details stay collapsed.

references.observed: One shared factory scene; three outcome-led steps with only the current description expanded; short spatial labels and one contextual detail card.
Separate visual roles for the workstation illustration, system relationship diagram and actual product screenshot.

adaptation.structure: Find / Understand / Move forward; four sequential project states in the third chapter.

rules: One headline and one short introductory sentence per chapter.
A maximum of three capability labels.
Before and After remain brief; no comparison matrix.
Use real demo captures, with mobile touchpoints in the corresponding phase.
No automatic motion; keyboard and button controls follow the same linear route.
SEO performance and the existing internal quotation process remain unverified.
Branding harness is a proposed ongoing pilot, not a shipped automation platform.
